<thought>We need to locate a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to deprotecting a TMS ether back to an alcohol (breaking O‑Si, forming O‑H). The search tool only accepts numeric bond specifications, so we’ll query using the functional group broken (“aliphatic hydroxyls”) which matches the forward protection step. This should return candidate templates with their IDs.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
